module: "g2g" background activity: on activation, fade to black, spawn of a random vehicle (car or truck with Top Speed > 10), then fade from black, all via util_stepHandler. On deactivation, the created vehicles are deleted. getVehicleOptions builds (and caches) the list of candidate models and configs from core_vehicles.getVehicleList().
notes: vehicleCount is 1: only one vehicle is created.
The filter mode is frozen to 'Default' in getVehicleOptions; the other modes (Old Cars, Race and Rally, Off-road...) are never active.
activate() sets active = true right at the start, activateFinished sets it to true again at the end of the sequence.
deactivate() does not set active back to false: after a deactivation, isActive() stays true and toggleActive()/activate() recreate nothing (activate returns if active is true). Probable game bug.
onUpdate and onDeserialized are empty functions; onVehicleSwitched does nothing (call commented out).

activate.desc: Activates the activity: no effect if already active. Launches a sequence of steps (fade to black, spawn of a random vehicle among getVehicleOptions, fade from black) that calls activateFinished at the end. The ids of the created vehicles are stored.

activateFinished.desc: End callback of the activation sequence: logs and forces active = true.

deactivate.desc: Deletes the created vehicles (notifies the editor if present, then obj:delete()) and empties the id list. No effect if the activity is not active.

toggleActive.desc: Deactivates the activity if it is active, otherwise activates it.

isActive.desc: Tells whether the activity is active.

returns.desc: true if active; nil as long as it has never been activated.

getVehicleOptions.desc: Returns (and caches) the list of candidate vehicles: models of type Car or Truck, excluding buses and auxiliaries, with at least one config whose Top Speed > 10 and that is not auxiliary.

returns.type: table<integer, {model: string, configs: table[], paints: string[]}>
returns.desc: Each entry: model key, configs {config, name} and paint names.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of a level: deactivates the activity.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook called when the controlled vehicle changes: does nothing.

onSerialize.desc: Hook called before the extensions reload: deactivates the activity.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called after the extensions reload: empty body.

onCareerActive.desc: Hook called when career mode changes state; deactivates the activity if career becomes active.
